text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right. Now that I've got new shoelaces, I guess it's time to head to training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The banner at that motorcycle shop over there… Th-there's no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's a remake of the legendary JUV1331 model!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I can't take it! I've just gotta go over there and check it out!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aughhh! Look at this dark gray sheen! It's so bold! So in your face!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Man, it's too cool! Just the best! It's even cooler than it looks in pictures!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Chances like this just don't come up any normal day. I gotta take it all in! Till it's permanently burned into my retinas!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka, completely glued to the motorcycle of her dreams, ends up neglecting her training…
